description: This file defines utility delegates and a static class for dynamically accessing and modifying fields of value types using reflection and IL emission in the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: FieldAccessor
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate delegates for getting and setting fields of types via reflection and IL emission.

methods.name: GetGetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to get the value of a specified field, either by reference or by value.

methods.name: GetValueGetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to get the value of a specified field, optimized for value types.

methods.name: GetSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field, either by reference or by value.

methods.name: GetReferenceSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field for an instance.

methods.name: GetValueSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field for an instance, optimized for value types.
